The official website for the new Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Akogare no Yume e - Magokoro no Duo (Fairy Princess Minky Momo) announced an additional pair of cast on Friday. The OVA is scheduled to open in theaters on November 13. Voice actors Youko Hikasa (Shunkashuutou Daikousha: Haru no Mai) and Tomohito Takatsuka (Kageki Shojo!!) are joining the cast as Peter and Rubert, respectively.
